sum: A week on forest ridges above Ghandruk and Ghorepani to the community lodge on Khopra Danda at 3,660 m, with an optional long day to Khayer Lake.
reach: By tourist bus (7–9 hours) or by air (about 25 minutes).

guide.note: Since April 2023 the Nepal Tourism Board has required foreign trekkers in conservation areas to walk with a licensed guide, though checks on the trail are inconsistent. Here a guide does two specific jobs: reserving beds in the small community lodges, and finding the way on the poorly marked forest and ridge sections between Dobato, Bayeli and Chistibang, where paths fork and cloud is common.

access: Take a jeep from Pokhara to Ghandruk, about three hours, and start walking the same day. The trek comes out at Tikhedhunga on the Ghorepani trail, where jeeps return to Pokhara through Nayapul in two and a half to three hours.

photo.a: A snow-covered ridge top in the foreground looks across a deep valley to the white massif of Dhaulagiri under a dark blue sky.

includes: porter in most packages (the cheapest tiers leave one out)
community lodge beds and three meals a day on the trek
jeep or bus between Pokhara and the trailheads

permits.name: Annapurna Conservation Area Permit
permits.where: Online at NTNC's e-permit site, or in person at the Tourist Service Centre in Bhrikutimandap, Kathmandu, and the Nepal Tourism Board office in Pokhara. A permit issued at a trail checkpost costs double.

permits.name: Trekkers' Information Management System card
permits.where: Only through a registered trekking agency, which applies in the Nepal Tourism Board's online system with your route and your guide's details. Individual trekkers can no longer buy one over the counter.

transportText: Tourist bus between Kathmandu and Pokhara both ways, and shared jeeps between Pokhara and the trail
tips: Have your guide or agency reserve the community lodges at Chistibang and Khopra Danda; there is only one at each.
Carry a sleeping bag. Blankets are provided, but nights on the ridge are below freezing in spring and autumn.
Bring cash for the whole trek. The last cash machines are in Pokhara.
Carry snacks and a packed lunch on the Bayeli section, where kitchens are slow and choices few.
Mobile signal is patchy north of Tadapani, so do not count on it for bookings or navigation.

days.t: Drive to Ghandruk, walk to Tadapani
days.note: About three hours by jeep from Pokhara, then lunch in Ghandruk and a steady climb of 700 m through oak and rhododendron forest to the clearing at Tadapani. If you set off late, sleep in Ghandruk and add a day.

The trail leaves the Ghorepani path and climbs north-west along a forested ridge through the clearings of Meshar and Isharu. It is an 800 m gain to a sleeping height above 3,400 m, so go slowly. Lodges at Dobato are few and simple.

Climb half an hour to Muldai for sunrise on Dhaulagiri and the Annapurnas, then follow the ridge to the community lodge at Bayeli. From there the path drops through forest and traverses steep hillside to Chistibang. Sleeping 400 m lower tonight helps your body catch up.

A short, steep climb of about 650 m through the last trees onto open grass. You are on the ridge by lunch, with the whole afternoon for Dhaulagiri and the gorge below. Yaks graze around the lodge and danphe pheasants are sometimes seen.
why: Sleeping altitude rises 660 m, well over the 500 m guideline even with a rest night next to it.

days.t: Optional day: Khayer Lake and back
days.note: Leave by five with a packed lunch and plenty of water. The path traverses and climbs the grassy flank of Annapurna South to the lake and its small shrine, about 1,000 m above the lodge, with no shelter on the way. Skip it in cloud or snow and take a rest day on the ridge instead.

Back down to Chistibang, then on through forest and across a stream to the terraced fields of Swanta, a descent of more than 1,400 m. The village sees few trekkers and its lodges cook with vegetables from the fields around them.

Drop to the Ghar Khola, climb to Chitre on the main Tatopani trail and follow it up through rhododendron forest to Ghorepani. After a week of quiet lodges the size of the village comes as a surprise. Walk up Poon Hill for sunset if the sky is clear.
med: Gorepani Comunal Healt Social Reform Group

days.t: Poon Hill, down to Tikhedhunga, drive to Pokhara
days.note: Go up Poon Hill before dawn and come back for breakfast, then descend 1,300 m through Banthanti and down the Ulleri staircase to the road at Tikhedhunga. Jeeps from there reach Pokhara in under three hours.
